units.source_text: 太政大臣随驾行幸野外，大约是古有先例的吧。

en.t: There was probably an ancient precedent for the Grand Minister accompanying the imperial outing into the countryside.

units.source_text: 源氏接得钦使赐品，诚惶诚恐，便款待他。

en.t: Genji received the gifts brought by the imperial messenger with deep reverence and awe, and then entertained him hospitably.
